/api/v1.guide: A GET reads and changes nothing. A setting is written with a PATCH of its resource, any of its fields at once, checked whole: if one field is refused, nothing is written. A setting written is live at once, or when its schema's 'applies' says; 'saved' in each settings reply says whether what runs is what is stored, and a POST of {} to the resource's save path stores it. A write may be refused for a moment with 409 busy: the charge's, the scale's and the gate's settings and the powder profile in use while a throw is under way, the motors' while the charge or a purge runs. GET /api/v1/schema describes every field. Weights are in the scale's own unit. The unit runs one job at a time: a charge or a purge. A charge is started with POST /api/v1/charge/start once a target is set, and throws until it is stopped: each throw waits for the scale to read zero, pours to the target, gives its verdict, and waits for the cup to be lifted and put back. POST /api/v1/stop stops whatever job runs, and never fails; a job that ended on a fault waits in 'fault' until a stop or a press at the unit. Follow GET /api/v1/events?after=N&wait=30 to see each change, from where you left off. The unit cannot know what is in the cup, nor whether the hopper holds powder: a zero and then a start pours onto whatever is on the pan. Start, and zero, only when a person has said an empty cup is on the pan.
